title: HUD TODO Manifest: Visual Target Gaps
summary: Line-by-line gap analysis between visual targets and current code. Bobby reads this directly. Updated v9: Invisible hotspot spec replaces diamond overlays. Council chat spec (one stream, all agents). Dream HUD implementation checklist. Priority order v10.

OPEN ITEMS (Bobby needs to fix these)

Priority order: top to bottom.

1. DAYTIME MODE: Full Theme (Patrik Directive, #1 PRIORITY)

Bobby shipped time-based IMAGE swap (commit 4e101fc). The building image changes between full-office-warm-night.png (before 9pm) and office-full-night.png (after 9pm). But the full daytime theme is NOT implemented yet. The image swap alone does not change the HUD, sidebar, text colors, or any UI element. The current daytime just uses the warm-night image with the full dark theme UI on top.

Daytime office asset now DELIVERED: Steffen generated office-full-daytime-v2.png and committed to aom-studio at /corner/office-full.png. Bobby's code already references this path. Image swap is UNBLOCKED.

What's missing (the big lift):

Bobby already has isNightMode conditional in the sidebar (lines 3535-3544, 3563-3566). The same pattern needs to be applied exhaustively to ALL UI elements:

  • Top HUD bar: dark glass -> white glass (rgba(255,255,255,0.92) + blur(12px))
  • Sidebar: dark gradient -> light (rgba(248,250,255,0.98)). PARTIALLY DONE. Bobby has isNightMode conditionals in the sidebar bg (line 3536) and borders (line 3539). Need to verify all child elements also switch.
  • All text: light on dark -> dark on light (#0F172A / #1E293B). PARTIALLY DONE. Agent name (line 3591) and role colors switch. Need to verify chat text, tab labels, stat labels.
  • Chat bubbles: dark backgrounds -> light backgrounds. DONE in sidebar (lines 3888-3910 have isNightMode branching).
  • Stat pills: dark -> light. PARTIALLY DONE (line 3659-3660 have isNightMode).
  • Camera controls: dark -> white glass
  • Floating stats: dark -> white glass
  • Room nameplates: gold -> dark brown
  • CORNER sign: glowing gold -> dark navy (#1E3A5F)
  • Sun/moon toggle button in top HUD bar (not yet added)
  • localStorage persistence for manual override
  • Game viewport background: void (#0A0F1E) -> sky gradient (#7EC8E3 top -> #B8E6D0 -> #8BC34A bottom)

Visual target: projects/steffen/visual-target/hud/dream-hud-v1.png (daytime + dream sidebar) Full palette spec: See APPENDIX below

2. Space Grotesk: MegaboardMode.jsx (11 instances)

FILE: src/dashboard/MegaboardMode.jsx (MULTIPLE LINES)
FOUND: 11 instances of 'Space Grotesk, sans-serif' at lines 172, 212, 254, 317, 349, 366, 404, 466, 551, 670, 728.
TODO: Global find/replace 'Space Grotesk, sans-serif' with "'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif"

3. Space Grotesk: gridSpec.js (1 instance, dead reference)

FILE: src/dashboard/gridSpec.js LINE: 258
CURRENT: nameplateFont: 'Space Grotesk'
TODO: Change to 'Inter'. Not actively used (SVG nameplate was fixed directly) but should be consistent.
      Low priority since it's not referenced in rendering code.

4. INVISIBLE HOTSPOT Room Interaction (Patrik Directive, UPDATED Mar 17)

SUPERSEDES OVO diamond overlay spec. Diamond outlines are DEAD.

Patrik (Mar 17): "The walls already define the rooms. NO visible diamond overlays. NO drawn outlines. INVISIBLE click regions that follow the wall boundaries."

Full spec: projects/steffen/invisible-hotspot-spec.md Visual reference: projects/steffen/visual-target/hud/dream-hud-v1.png

Bobby creates these files:

  • components/RoomOverlay.tsx (SVG, viewBox 0 0 1000 1000, invisible polygons)
  • components/RoomLabels.tsx (DOM-positioned room name labels)
  • public/corner/skins/daytime-v2/room-config.json (polygon coords traced from walls)
  • styles/room-overlay.css (hover glow transitions)

Three interaction states:

DEFAULT: Polygon fill TRANSPARENT. Stroke NONE. Only agent dots + name labels visible. Cursor default. HOVER: Polygon fill rgba(255,255,255,0.08). Subtle glow WITHIN wall boundaries. Agent dot scale(1.2). Cursor pointer. SELECTED: Polygon fill rgba(59,130,246,0.12). Agent dot pulsing ring. Sidebar switches. Camera zooms.

Bobby traces actual wall boundaries from the office image pixel-by-pixel (~30 min per skin). No diamond shapes.

4b. COUNCIL CHAT: One Stream, All Agents (Patrik Directive, NEW Mar 17)

SUPERSEDES per-agent separate chat panels.

Patrik (Mar 17): "Chat is a running COUNCIL. All agents in the same stream. Switch by saying 'talk to Steffen' or clicking an agent."

Full spec: projects/steffen/council-chat-spec.md

Bobby creates/updates:

  • components/CouncilChat.tsx (single stream chat)
  • components/AgentSwitchEvent.tsx (timeline markers)
  • components/SystemEvent.tsx (commit/status pills)
  • hooks/useCouncilStream.ts (merge inbox+outbox by timestamp)
  • Update GameDashboard.jsx (replace per-agent routing with council)

Key behaviors:

  • All messages from ALL agents + ALL Patrik sources in ONE chronological list
  • Agents on LEFT (dark gray bubbles), Patrik on RIGHT (blue bubbles)
  • "talk to [name]" switches active agent (regex: /^talk to (\w+)/i)
  • Agent switch = centered timeline marker, NOT a new conversation
  • System events (commits, status) as centered monospace pills

5. Fixed Zoom Levels (Patrik Directive)

TODO(patrik): Replace free scroll zoom with 1-2 preset snap levels
(e.g., overview + detail). Fixed zoom = consistent click targets on
desktop and mobile. No free scroll zoom. Snap to presets on scroll
or button click.

NOTE: Current code has ZOOM_LEVELS (OVERVIEW 0.55-1.0, NEIGHBORHOOD 1.0-2.0,
DETAIL 2.0-2.5) but still allows free scroll between them.
Patrik wants SNAP behavior: scroll or button click jumps to the next preset.

6. DREAM SIDEBAR: Stat Pills as Boxed Grid (dream-sidebar-v1.png gap)

The dream-sidebar-v1.png shows stat pills as a 4-column boxed grid layout:

+--------+--------+--------+--------+
|   5    |   1    |   7    | 63%    |
| ACTIVE | BLOCKED|  DONE  |PROGRESS|
+--------+--------+--------+--------+

Each box is a distinct bordered card with the number LARGE above (16-18px, 900 weight) and the label BELOW (11px, uppercase). Current code renders them as inline horizontal pills in a single row. The dream target uses a boxed grid where each stat has its own contained card.

CURRENT (GameDashboard.jsx line 3644-3684):
  display: flex, gap: 6, flexWrap: wrap
  Each pill: inline flex, label NEXT TO number

DREAM TARGET:
  display: grid, gridTemplateColumns: repeat(4, 1fr), gap: 8
  Each box: flex column, number ABOVE, label BELOW
  min-height: 48px, text-align: center
  Border: 2px solid with stat color at 0.2 opacity
  Background: stat color at 0.06 opacity
  Border-radius: 8px

7. DREAM SIDEBAR: Agent Role Uppercase + Smaller (dream-sidebar-v1.png gap)

CURRENT (GameDashboard.jsx line 3597-3602):
  fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 600, color: agentColor

DREAM TARGET (dream-sidebar-v1.png):
  fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 700, color: agentColor
  textTransform: uppercase
  letterSpacing: 0.06em

The agent role text ("WEB DEV AGENT") is uppercase, smaller, and more
letter-spaced in the dream target. More refined, less dominant.

8. DREAM SIDEBAR: Status Badge Pill (dream-sidebar-v1.png gap)

The dream target shows a small green status badge pill below the role text:

CURRENT: No explicit status badge. Status shown only via the dot on avatar.

DREAM TARGET:
  <span class="agent-status-badge">
    <span class="badge-dot" (5px green circle)></span>
    ACTIVE
  </span>

  font-size: 11px, font-weight: 700
  color: #16A34A (green text)
  background: rgba(34,197,94,0.1)
  border: 1px solid rgba(34,197,94,0.2)
  border-radius: 4px
  padding: 2px 8px
  text-transform: uppercase
  letter-spacing: 0.06em

Dynamic: color/bg/border change per status. Green=ACTIVE, Red=BLOCKED,
Blue=DONE, Gray=IDLE.

9. DREAM SIDEBAR: Monospace for Source Labels + Timestamps (dream-sidebar-v1.png gap)

CURRENT (GameDashboard.jsx line 3936, 3945):
  Source labels: fontFamily "'Inter', sans-serif", fontSize 12
  Timestamps: fontFamily "'Inter', sans-serif", fontSize 12

DREAM TARGET (render-dream-sidebar.html):
  Source labels: fontFamily 'JetBrains Mono', monospace, fontSize 10px
    letter-spacing: 0.06em
    background: rgba(59,130,246,0.06), border: 1px solid rgba(59,130,246,0.1)
    border-radius: 3px, padding: 1px 6px
  Timestamps: fontFamily 'JetBrains Mono', monospace, fontSize 10px
    font-weight: 500, color: #94A3B8

  DATE SEPARATOR ("TODAY"):
    fontFamily: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace
    fontSize: 11px, fontWeight: 700
    letter-spacing: 0.12em

JetBrains Mono gives monospace source labels a "terminal" feel that matches
the "VIA TERMINAL" / "VIA TELEGRAM" energy. Inter looks too casual for these.

10. DREAM SIDEBAR: Send Button Shape (dream-sidebar-v1.png gap)

CURRENT (GameDashboard.jsx line 4010-4022):
  width: 42, height: 42, borderRadius: '50%'  (circular)
  Icon: Play (filled triangle)

DREAM TARGET (render-dream-sidebar.html):
  width: 38, height: 38, borderRadius: 11px  (rounded rectangle)
  Icon: paper plane / send arrow (SVG path)
  Background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3B82F6 0%, #2563EB 100%)
  box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgba(59,130,246,0.3)

The rectangular send button with the paper plane icon feels more like
a chat app (iMessage, Telegram). The circular play button feels more
like a media player. Dream target chose chat app energy.

11. DREAM SIDEBAR: Typing Indicator with Label (dream-sidebar-v1.png gap)

CURRENT: Typing dots appear inside a chat bubble with full 36px SpriteAvatar.
  No text label. Just bouncing dots inside a message-like container.

DREAM TARGET:
  Separate typing row (not inside a bubble):
  [30px avatar] [3 bouncing dots] "Bobby is typing..."

  Avatar: 30px (smaller than chat avatar)
  Dots: 6px circles, agent color, bounce keyframe
  Label: font-size 13px, color #94A3B8, font-style italic, font-weight 500

  The label makes it CLEAR that a response is coming. Just dots alone
  can look like a loading error. "Bobby is typing..." is human.

12. DREAM HUD: Top Bar Agent Info (dream-hud-v1.png gap)

CURRENT: Top bar shows CORNER. logo, LOCAL badge, stat pills, search, bell.
  No selected agent info in top bar.

DREAM TARGET (dream-hud-v1.png):
  Top bar left-center shows the currently selected agent:
  [Bobby avatar 28px] Bobby  ACTIVE  |  [stat pills...]

  This gives the top bar a "who am I looking at" indicator that
  stays visible even when scrolling chat. It connects the game
  viewport selection to the HUD strip.

  On click: same as clicking the agent avatar in sidebar.
  Visual: 28px avatar circle, agent name 14px bold, ACTIVE badge pill.

13. DREAM HUD: Bottom Status Bar (dream-hud-v1.png gap)

CURRENT: No bottom bar (ChatBar was removed per Patrik directive).

DREAM TARGET (dream-hud-v1.png):
  Small bottom-left status pill: "6 Active  0 Blocked"
  Positioned at absolute bottom-left of game viewport.
  Compact, non-intrusive. Just two numbers.

  background: rgba(15,23,42,0.85) / rgba(255,255,255,0.85) (day/night)
  border-radius: 8px
  padding: 6px 12px
  font-size: 13px, JetBrains Mono, 600
  Green dot before Active count, Red dot before Blocked count.

  NOTE: This is NOT a full bottom bar. It's a tiny floating pill
  that gives at-a-glance status when the sidebar is closed.
  Only appears when sidebar panel is NOT visible.

14. Mobile Bottom-Sheet Drawer (Steffen Design)

TODO(steffen-design): Design the swipe-up drawer for mobile.
Should show: agent name/status at peek height, chat on half-pull,
full panel on full-pull. Reference Steffen's c3-mobile-layout-spec.md.
The notification cards currently overlap the bottom bar on mobile.

15. "Right Now" Pill: Top Bar + Dropdown (Steffen Designed)

Visual target: projects/steffen/visual-target/hud/right-now-pill.png Source HTML: projects/steffen/visual-target/hud/render-right-now-pill.html

The "Right Now" pill shows live running agents in the top HUD bar. Three components:

A. Collapsed pill (always visible in top bar):

  • Position: after LOCAL badge, before stat pills
  • Contains: "RIGHT NOW" label (JetBrains Mono 10px/800, #3B82F6, uppercase), stacked agent avatars (24px with 2px white border, pulse ring animation), count badge (JetBrains Mono 12px/700, blue bg), chevron
  • Background: rgba(59,130,246,0.05), border 1.5px solid rgba(59,130,246,0.18), border-radius 10px
  • Hover: scale(1.02) translateY(-1px), border-color rgba(59,130,246,0.35), box-shadow 0 3px 12px rgba(59,130,246,0.12)
  • Spring physics: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)

B. Dropdown panel (on pill click):

  • Width: 400px, border-radius 14px, white glass background
  • Header: green live dot (pulsing) + "RIGHT NOW" title + "3 running" count
  • Task rows: drag grip (6-dot pattern) + 32px agent avatar (with pulse ring) + task name (14px/700) + agent label + progress bar (6px, agent-colored gradient, shimmer animation) + elapsed time (JetBrains Mono 10px) + status dot
  • Footer: "Drag to re-prioritize" hint + "View All Tasks" link
  • All CSS specs in the source HTML, Bobby can extract directly

C. Floating "Right Now" mini (bottom-right of game viewport, when sidebar hidden):

  • Stacked 22px avatars + "3 Live" label + animated micro progress bar (40px)
  • Frosted glass: rgba(255,255,255,0.92), blur(12px), border-radius 10px
  • Hover: translateY(-2px), deeper shadow
  • Only visible when sidebar panel is NOT shown

16. Bottom Bar: Kill It + Floating Status Pill (Steffen Designed)

Visual target: projects/steffen/visual-target/hud/bottom-bar-redesign.png Source HTML: projects/steffen/visual-target/hud/render-bottom-bar-redesign.html

Steffen recommendation: Option A. Kill the bottom bar entirely.

Replace with floating status pill at bottom-left of game viewport:

  • Contains: green dot + "5" + "Active" | divider | red dot + "0" + "Blocked"
  • Background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92), blur(12px), border-radius 10px
  • Font: JetBrains Mono 13px/800 for numbers, Inter 11px/600 for labels
  • Only visible when sidebar panel is NOT shown
  • Pairs with the "Right Now" mini pill at bottom-right (item 15C above)

Why kill it: Patrik killed the ChatBar. Dream-hud-v1 has no bottom bar. Any permanent strip competes with the game world. On mobile it's worse. Let the game breathe.

PRIORITY ORDER FOR BOBBY (v10, updated Mar 17)

  1. DAYTIME MODE full theme. Image swap done, daytime office asset delivered. HUD/sidebar/text colors need day/night branching completed. #1 visual gap. Patrik directive.
  2. MegaboardMode Space Grotesk. DONE (6f83422).
  3. gridSpec.js Space Grotesk. DONE (6f83422).
  4. INVISIBLE HOTSPOTS. Spec UPDATED: invisible-hotspot-spec.md (replaces diamond overlay). Trace wall boundaries, invisible polygons, OVO approach. Patrik directive. 4b. COUNCIL CHAT. Spec NEW: council-chat-spec.md. One stream, all agents, no per-agent separation. Patrik directive.
  5. Fixed zoom levels. Snap behavior instead of free scroll.
  6. Stat pills boxed grid. DONE (6f83422).
  7. Agent role uppercase + status badge. DONE (6f83422).
  8. Monospace source labels + timestamps. DONE (6f83422).
  9. Send button rectangular + paper plane. DONE (6f83422).
  10. Typing indicator with label. DONE (6f83422).
  11. Top bar agent info. Already implemented.
  12. Bottom status pill. Floating "5 Active 0 Blocked" pill, only when sidebar hidden. 10 min.
  13. "Right Now" pill in top bar + dropdown. Steffen design delivered. 30-45 min.
  14. "Right Now" floating mini (bottom-right). Pairs with bottom status pill. 15 min.
  15. Mobile bottom-sheet. Steffen design needed first.

Also see: dream-hud-implementation-checklist.md for the full pixel-matching checklist (covers ALL elements from dream-hud-v1.png).

Bobby sequence: Daytime theme > Invisible hotspots > Council chat > Fixed zoom > Floating pills > Right Now feature > Mobile.

  - Top HUD border: 2px solid rgba(59,130,246,0.25)
  - Top HUD shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)

  - Sidebar: rgba(248,250,255,0.98) gradient
  - Sidebar border: 2px solid rgba(59,130,246,0.35) (matches current code)
  - Sidebar shadow: -8px 0 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)
  - Chat bubbles: agent rgba(agent,0.06), user rgba(59,130,246,0.06)
  - Chat bubble border: 1.5px solid rgba(agent/blue,0.12-0.15)
  - Chat bubble shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)
  - Chat bubble radius: 16px (slightly rounder than night's 14px)
  - Text primary: #0F172A / #1E293B (dark text on light bg)
  - Text secondary: #64748B / #94A3B8
  - Accent blue: #2563EB
  - Borders: rgba(59,130,246,0.08-0.20) (same blue, lower opacity)
  - Game viewport: sky gradient (#7EC8E3 top -> #A8D8EA -> #B8E6D0 -> #8BC34A -> #6B9F3A bottom)
  - Room interiors: warm light backgrounds (rgba(250,245,238,0.95) / rgba(240,235,228,0.95))
  - Room nameplates: dark brown (rgba(80,60,30,0.8)) instead of gold
  - Room nameplate font: Inter (not Space Grotesk)
  - Room grid bg: rgba(60,50,40,0.85) (warm dark brown, not navy)
  - Room grid border: 3px solid rgba(120,90,50,0.4)
  - Camera controls: white glass (rgba(255,255,255,0.85), blur(8px))
  - Camera control text: #64748B
  - Tab key badges: same spec as night
  - Stat pills: rgba(59,130,246,0.04) bg, rgba(59,130,246,0.1) border
  - Floating stats: rgba(255,255,255,0.85) bg, #334155 text
  - CORNER sign: #1E3A5F (dark navy, not glowing gold)
  - Chat source pill: JetBrains Mono 10px, blue bg on white, not blue bg on dark
  - Agent avatar status dot: #22C55E, 15px, 2.5px white border (dream) or 18px 3px (current)
  - Status badge: green pill with dot + "ACTIVE" text
  - Agent role: 13px uppercase 700 weight, agent color

NIGHTTIME PALETTE (current dark theme, unchanged):
  - Everything as-is now. No changes to night mode.

LOGIC: Check new Date().getHours(). If >= 21 || < 6 => night. Else => day.
Store theme in state. Provide manual toggle button (sun/moon icon) in top HUD bar.
Sun icon for day mode: golden circle (#FFD54F). Shows current mode.
Moon icon for night mode: crescent (#94A3B8). Shows current mode.
Click toggles. Stored in localStorage so it persists.
